title: CanAssist Breast machine-learning test validated blind in a European breast cancer cohort
summary: CanAssist Breast, an immunohistochemistry test with a machine-learning algorithm, was validated blind in 864 patients from Spain, Italy, Austria and Germany; it had been developed in an Indian cohort. It separated low- and high-risk groups for recurrence, with HR 2.93 (1.44-5.96) in women over 50 and 2.57 (1.26-5.26) in N1 disease, and called 77% low-risk versus 55% by IHC4. The validation is retrospective and the test is commercial.
ai_technology: Machine-learning algorithm computing a recurrence risk score from immunohistochemistry markers

evidence.tested: Recurrence risk stratification was tested against outcomes from medical records in 864 patients.
evidence.unknown: Effect on treatment decisions is not tested. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A machine-learning algorithm converted IHC marker data into a recurrence risk score.
